roads.name: County Road 3640
words: Sweeping and steady: 11 curves in 4.5 miles.

July highs average 95°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 45 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.48 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
